firmware.releaseNotes: First owner-controlled OTA target for the P01/U01 3.3.41 receiver and original-signed App 1.0.88+114. Version-only firmware change; all functional inputs remain identical to 3.3.41 from main 50b9af34090214e1a64424d6280352bcfd6aa82f. Keep this as an unpublished candidate until the owner publishes Stable and generates/enables the exact 3.3.41 to 3.3.42 delta. Test autonomous discovery/MCU notification, global prompt, Later, true durable/stage progress, post-reboot target identity, persistent history and native recovery diagnostics. Preserve explicit consent, same-package suppression, recording/power/storage gates, Boot/configuration/user data, keys and protocol. No automatic channel publication or delta generation; 3.3.43 must not skip this first test round. App version is unchanged and must not be rebuilt for this firmware-only delivery.
